import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_10/training_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history:
# Group by PRECINCT and sum the following columns:
# ELIGIBLE_VOTERS, POLLS, EARLY_VOING, ABSENTEE, PROVISIONAL

# Ensure the columns are of correct types before aggregation
# ELIGIBLE_VOTERS in source is float (from example), target expects integer
# So sum and then convert to int

agg_columns = ['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS', 'POLLS', 'EARLY_VOING', 'ABSENTEE', 'PROVISIONAL']

# Convert aggregation columns to numeric (in case of any issues)
for col in agg_columns:
    df_source0[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_source0[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

# Group by PRECINCT and aggregate sums
df_agg = df_source0.groupby('PRECINCT', as_index=False)[agg_columns].sum()

# Convert aggregated columns to integer as per target schema
df_agg['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS'] = df_agg['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS'].round().astype(int)
df_agg['POLLS'] = df_agg['POLLS'].round().astype(int)
df_agg['EARLY_VOING'] = df_agg['EARLY_VOING'].round().astype(int)
df_agg['ABSENTEE'] = df_agg['ABSENTEE'].round().astype(int)
df_agg['PROVISIONAL'] = df_agg['PROVISIONAL'].round().astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
target_columns = ['PRECINCT', 'ELIGIBLE_VOTERS', 'POLLS', 'EARLY_VOING', 'ABSENTEE', 'PROVISIONAL']
df_target = df_agg[target_columns]

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_10/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
